integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.intro: Integrations connect Mudrix to other apps. They come from repositories and are descriptions (which links to recognise, which buttons, commands and requests to offer). The one exception is a widget: it runs code from its own website in an isolated frame, and Mudrix always labels it "Runs code". They are kept on this device. Repositories are signed; Mudrix checks every signature and pins the publisher's key when you first add one.
integrations.availableEmpty: Add a repository below to find integrations.
integrations.repositoriesNote: A repository is a repo.json on any https host. Paste its URL, or a github.com repository with a repo.json at its root. Repositories are signed; Mudrix checks every signature and pins the publisher's key when you first add one.
integrations.sourceGone: Its source no longer offers it (the repository or the integration was removed). It keeps working, but will not receive updates.

keyChanged.title: This repository now uses a different signing key
keyChanged.body: Mudrix refused its update because the key no longer matches the one you trusted. Remove it and add it again only if you expected the publisher to change keys.

trust.title: Trust this publisher?
trust.rejected_other: {{count}} more are listed but can't be used:
trust.rejected_one: {{count}} more is listed but can't be used:
trust.explain: Mudrix only accepts updates to this repository that are signed with this key. If the author gave you a fingerprint, check that it matches. Whoever holds this key can change what these integrations ask for; anything new still needs your approval before it switches on. If the repository ever uses a different key, Mudrix refuses it.

consent.title: Install {{name}}?
consent.intro: If you install this, it will be allowed to:
consent.safety: Nothing runs from the repository and nothing is sent anywhere. Buttons only put text in the message box; you choose whether to send it. You can switch off any permission or uninstall at any time.
consent.safetyApi: Nothing runs from the repository. Nothing is sent until you use one of these actions and confirm the request, which shows exactly what is sent. You can switch off any permission or uninstall at any time.
consent.safetyDetails: Nothing runs from the repository. Your device contacts only the services named above: to look up matching links (showing only the fields listed), and for any action only after you confirm it. You can switch off any permission or uninstall at any time.
consent.safetyCode: Nothing runs until you open the widget yourself. You can switch off any permission or uninstall at any time.

hosts.title: Servers it may contact
hosts.note: Every other address is refused, and no cookies or account details are sent.

warning.title: This integration runs code
warning.source: The code comes from {{host}} and is loaded from there every time it is opened.
warning.changes: Its author can change it at any time without Mudrix asking you again.
warning.isolated: It runs in an isolated frame and cannot read your messages, keys or account, except through the things listed below that you allow.
warning.trust: Install only integrations from people you trust.
